summary:
Surgical overhaul of the Cinema playback pipeline, VidLink time synchronization, external timeline, and details modal performance:
1. Confirmed VidLink (server-vl) at index 0 as the primary Tier 2 server with capabilities { timeEvents: true, startAt: true } and direct URL loading (no workerBridge).
2. Upgraded speed cache to nl_cinema_server_speed_v2 with strict two-bucket sorting to permanently protect Tier 2 time-reporting servers over Tier 3 silent embeds.
3. Cleaned videoExtractor Tier 1 logic by eliminating clean-embed promotions (which previously hijacked VidLink with silent 2vcdn.skin embeds) and tightening timeout to 4500ms.
4. Updated iframeBridge with sessionKey reset, finite timestamp gating, MEDIA_DATA paused: false normalization, and Site-Isolation-safe origin regex.
5. Guarded CinemaTimeline to return null on mode === 'none' and stripped dummy manual clock controls.
6. Caches resolved IMDb IDs in MovieSourcesModal and memoized sources by primitive fields.
7. Made trailerService return YouTube trailers immediately at 0ms when available.
8. Synchronously pre-seeded detailedItem in MoviesPage for instant 0ms modal open, decoupled subtitle extraction, and unmounted heavy ambient blurs during modal display.
9. Passed all tests, CSP audit, TypeScript checks, and applet compilation.
